# Upstream SolidCraft workflows (parked)

These are SolidCraft's own GitHub Actions workflows, kept for reference. They are not in
`.github/workflows/`, so GitHub does not run them in this repository: they expect SolidCraft's
Blacksmith runners, release secrets, store accounts and issue bots.

Nuclear's own CI is `.github/workflows/nuclear.yml`. Move a workflow back (and adapt it) when we
need what it does.
